rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account, then used read-only tools to retrieve user and order details. It correctly declined a cross-category exchange (consistent with stated store policy in the conversation) and offered a compliant alternative (return after delivery). The agent did not perform any order-changing write without explicit confirmation and provided correct next steps based on order status. No unsupported claims about orders or items were made. One minor quibble is the promise to "remind" the user without showing a tool action to set a reminder, but this does not materially affect policy compliance or the handling of the request. Overall, the interaction aligns with the policy, though the original exchange request could not be completed due to rules, hence a lower completion probability.
